message:
Fix snapshot Service deadline locks and admit native local JWT batch tokens

The current release build rejects nine snapshot-forwarding Service lock calls because HaLock only applies to HaProcess. Use the existing deadline-aware Service helper with each original deadline, retaining error, audit, and uncertain-outcome handling.

Admit local JWT batch issuance through the existing sealed-batch and paired Auth/Namespace lifecycle. Retain the single original verifier lifetime, real Identity binding, clock, publication proof, and post-audit response checks. Add cold-reopen, stateless issuance, disabled Identity, expiry, policy, and audit regressions, including complete Namespace lifecycle failure snapshots.

Validation at commit creation: independent source review and exact forward/reverse source checks. Rust compilation, runtime regressions, and platform qualification remain pending. No production cutover or cleanup.
